chapters.summary: Council staff calls the meeting to order and Chair Riley welcomes colleagues including Brooks-Powers, Cabán, Abreu, Salaam, Banks, Zhuang, Encarnación, Sanchez, Thomas-Henry, and Minority Leader Carr. Riley notes the committee will vote on four proposals referred by the subcommittees and thanks Subcommittee Chairs Lewis and Marte for their leadership.
chapters.title: Chair Riley opens meeting and welcomes committee members

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Good morning and welcome to today's New York City Council vote on the Committee of Land Use.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time, please silence all electronic devices and no one may approach the dais.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Chair, you may begin.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the meeting of the Committee on Land Use.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I'm Councilmember Kevin Riley, chair of this committee.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I want to welcome my esteemed colleagues joining me today, including Councilmember Brooks Powers, Councilmember Caban, Majority Leader of Bayou, Councilmember Salam, Councilmember Banks, Councilmember Zhuang,

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Councilmember Encarnacion, Councilmember Justin Sanchez, Councilmember Thomas Henry, and Minority Leader David Carr.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Today we are voting on four proposals referred to us by our subcommittee.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: And like always, I would like to thank Chair Lewis in Zonin and Chair Marte in Landmarks for their ongoing leadership.

chapters.summary: Riley describes LU 114, which facilitates future acquisition and development of new parkland and open space to address the walk-to-park gap in Queens Community District 2, in the districts of Councilmembers Won and Krishnan. The committee will vote to approve.
chapters.title: Chair Riley outlines LU 114 — Queens CD2 Walk-to-Park acquisition

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Today, we will vote to approve LU's 114 related to the Queens Community District 2 walk-to-park acquisition and site selection in the districts of Councilmember Wan and Councilmember Krishnan.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: The proposed action will facilitate the future acquisition and development of a new parkland and open space resources to address the walk-to-park gap within Queens Council District 2.

chapters.summary: Riley explains the 200 Kent Avenue rezoning in Brooklyn, which includes a zoning map amendment and text amendment for a mixed-use residential project with approximately 143 apartments, up to 36 affordable through MIH. The committee's modification will remove MIH Option 2. Located in Councilmember Restler's district.
chapters.title: Chair Riley outlines LU 115/116 — 200 Kent Avenue rezoning with modifications

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We will also vote to approve with modifications LUs 115 and 116.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: related to the 200 Kent Avenue rezoning proposal in Councilmember Ressler's district in Brooklyn.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: For a zoning map amendment and zoning text amendment to facilitate the development of a mixed-use residential project, including approximately 143 apartments, of which up to 36 would permanently...

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Be affordable through the MIH program.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Our modification will be to remove MIH option two.

chapters.summary: Riley describes the 47-03 108th Street rezoning in Queens, Councilmember Thomas-Henry's district, for a mixed-use development with approximately 119 units including up to 30 affordable through MIH. The committee's modification will rezone the area as R7D rather than R7X based on predominant existing development patterns.
chapters.title: Chair Riley outlines LU 118/119 — 47-03 108th Street rezoning with modifications

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: And we will also vote to approve and modifications LUs 118 and 119 related to the 47-03-108 street

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: rezoning proposal in Councilmember Thomas Henry's district in Queens for a zoning map amendment and zoning text amendment, which together will facilitate the development of a new mixed-use development with approximately 119 units,

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: including up to 30 affordable units through MIH.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Our modification will be to rezone the project area as an R7D district rather than an R7X district based on the predominant existing development patterns in the surrounding area.

chapters.summary: Riley presents LU 117, which expands the existing Flatiron District concession area on portions of Broadway and Fifth Avenue in the districts of Councilmembers Epstein and Wilson. The expansion aims to create a more engaging and safer public realm for pedestrians and cyclists between East 19th Street and West 31st Street.
chapters.title: Chair Riley outlines LU 117 — Flatiron NoMad Major Concession

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We will also vote to approve L.U.'s 117 regarding the Flatiron Nomad Major Concession application.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: For portions of Broadway and Fifth Avenue in the districts of Councilmember Epstein and Councilmember Wilson.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: This application will expand the existing Flatiron District concession area.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: to facilitate a more engaging and a safer public realm for pedestrians and cyclists in and along Fifth Avenue and Broadway between East 19th Street and West 31st Street.

chapters.summary: Riley invites colleagues for comments or questions; seeing none, he calls for a vote to approve LU 114 and LU 117, and to approve with modifications LU 115/116 and LU 118/119. He asks the clerk to call the roll.
chapters.title: Chair Riley calls for vote on all coupled items

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I would like to recognize any colleagues for any comments or questions.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: There seeing none, I now call for a vote with the support of the local members to approve LUs 114 and LU 117 and to approve with modifications LUs 115 and 116 and LUs 118 and 119.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Clerk, can you please call the roll?

chapters.summary: Committee Clerk William Martin calls the roll with all items coupled. Each member votes in the affirmative: Riley, Brooks-Powers, Cabán, Abreu, Ossé, Salaam, Banks, Zhuang, Encarnación, Sanchez, Thomas-Henry, and Carr.

chapters.summary: Clerk announces the vote of 11 in the affirmative, zero in the negative, and no abstentions; all items approved as described by the chair. Riley thanks members, staff, and the public, and adjourns the meeting.
chapters.title: All items approved 11-0 and meeting adjourned

utterances.speaker: William Martin
utterances.text: With a vote of 11 in the affirmative, zero in the negative, and no abstentions, all items have been approved by the committee as described by the chair.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: That concludes today's business.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I would like to thank the members of the public, my colleagues, council staff, and the sergeant at arms for participating in today's meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: This meeting is hereby adjourned.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Thank you.

summary: Committee on Land Use, chaired by Councilmember Kevin Riley, voted on five land use applications referred from subcommittees.
All items passed 11-0, including approvals with modifications for 200 Kent Avenue rezoning (removing MIH Option 2) and 47-03 108th Street rezoning (changing to R7D district).
The committee also approved Queens CD2 Walk-to-Park site selection/acquisition and the Flatiron NoMad Major Concession expansion without modifications.
title: Committee on Land Use
topic: Landmarks, Queens CD 2 Walk to Park Site Selection/Acquisition, Queens (C 260089 PCQ)
